sloka: उत्तिष्ठ नरशार्दूल दीर्घवाहो दृढव्रत।किमात्मानं महात्मानमात्मानं नावबुध्यसे ।। ६.८३.४३ ।।
transliteration: uttiṣṭha naraśārdūla dīrghavāho dṛḍhavrata।kimātmānaṁ mahātmānamātmānaṁ nāvabudhyase ।। 6.83.43 ।।

translations.english: "O tiger among men! O broad shouldered endowed with fortitude! Why do you not know yourself that you are a great soul and doer of action?"
